        description: Immutable baseline commit (40 lowercase hex characters)
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_sha:
        description: Immutable candidate commit, must equal the frozen dispatch ref SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_mode:
        description: Reviewed source-pair mode, independently enforced by admission controls
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_source_base:
        description: Immutable reviewed baseline source epoch (40 lowercase hex characters)
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_source_head:
        description: Immutable reviewed candidate source epoch (40 lowercase hex characters)
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  automatic_capture_route:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      capture_required: ${{ steps.route.outputs.capture_required }}
    steps:
      - name: Route exact-case aggregate without untrusted expression interpolation
        id: route
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_PATH'], encoding='utf-8') as source:
              event = json.load(source)
          head = (event.get('pull_request') or {}).get('head') or {}
          repository = os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', '')
          skip = (os.environ.get('GITHUB_EVENT_NAME') == 'pull_request'
                  and bool(repository)
                  and (head.get('repo') or {}).get('full_name') == repository
                  and head.get('ref') == 'inkwave/qa-main26a4-integration-20261022')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
              output.write('capture_required=' + ('false' if skip else 'true') + '\n')
          PY
  capture:
    # An automatic skip is not acceptance; immutable manual comparison is required.
    needs: automatic_capture_route
    if: ${{ needs.automatic_capture_route.outputs.capture_required == 'true' }}
    name: Capture ${{ matrix.side }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    env:
      INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT: .ci-baseline
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        side: [before, after]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Verify immutable candidate and dispatch pair
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          PAIR_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          DISPATCH_BASE_SHA: ${{ inputs.base_sha }}
          DISPATCH_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.candidate_sha }}
          DISPATCH_MODE: ${{ inputs.expected_mode }}
          DISPATCH_SOURCE_BASE: ${{ inputs.expected_source_base }}
          DISPATCH_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ inputs.expected_source_head }}
        run: |
          [[ "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
          if [ "$PAIR_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            for sha in "$DISPATCH_BASE_SHA" "$DISPATCH_HEAD_SHA" "$DISPATCH_SOURCE_BASE" "$DISPATCH_SOURCE_HEAD"; do
              [[ "$sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
            done
            test "$DISPATCH_HEAD_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
            [[ "$DISPATCH_MODE" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]+$ ]]
          fi
      - name: Check out immutable base for the explicitly aligned reference
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1869 || github.head_ref == 'fix/inkwave-ci-composed-regressions-20261024')) }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number == 1651 && 'd42f3f26372361332bdf596ac88155b153557538' || github.event.pull_request.base.sha || inputs.base_sha }}
          path: .ci-baseline
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable baseline checkout before any alignment
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1869 || github.head_ref == 'fix/inkwave-ci-composed-regressions-20261024')) }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number == 1651 && 'd42f3f26372361332bdf596ac88155b153557538' || github.event.pull_request.base.sha || inputs.base_sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$(git -C .ci-baseline rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Verify fail-closed immutable workflow routes
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/tests/inkwave-exact-head-workflow-routes.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-main26a4-production-epoch.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-runtime-ui-production-epoch.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-current-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-main3003-firing-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-main3003-respawn-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-pr1869-current-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-pr1869-workflow-route.test.mjs
      - name: Verify historical projectile contracts only on their reviewed owner PR
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && ((github.event.pull_request.number == 1856 && github.head_ref == 'fix/roller-vertical-recovery-20261023') || (github.event.pull_request.number == 1862 && github.head_ref == 'fix/respawn-weapon-state-20261023') || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/special-reviewed-main726-20261023') }}
        run: |
          case "$GITHUB_HEAD_REF" in
            fix/roller-vertical-recovery-20261023) node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/tests/inkwave-roller-pr1856-projectile-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-roller-pr1856-pose-pair.test.mjs ;;
            fix/respawn-weapon-state-20261023) node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/tests/inkwave-respawn1862-production-pair.test.mjs ;;
            inkwave/special-reviewed-main726-20261023) node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/tests/inkwave-reviewed-special-delta-admission.test.mjs ;;
            *) echo 'Unreviewed archive route'; exit 1 ;;
          esac
      - name: Install pinned build and browser tools
        run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock esbuild@0.28.2 playwright@1.62.1 ws@8
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Verify native intro timers and strict UI admission
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: |
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-capture-ui.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-atomic-intro.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-ci-intro.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-intro-ui.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-capture-projection.test.mjs
          CHROMIUM_PATH="$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('playwright').chromium.executablePath())")"
          test -n "$CHROMIUM_PATH" && test -x "$CHROMIUM_PATH"
          export CHROMIUM_PATH
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-intro-ui-browser.test.mjs
      - name: Native visual, source-value and gameplay regressions
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: |
          node --experimental-vm-modules --test patches/splatoon3/tests/projectile-visuals.test.mjs patches/splatoon3/tests/slosher-draw-size-1014.test.mjs patches/splatoon3/tests/roller-draw-radius.test.mjs tests/ink-flight/model.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-pool-reset.test.mjs
          python3 scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-captures.test.py
          node --experimental-vm-modules --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-ci-intro.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-ci-roster.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-character-reset.test.mjs
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-pr-diff-cli.test.mjs
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-23pr-paint-source-pair.test.mjs
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-main9fe-paint-admission.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-maine1f-paint-admission.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-ci-source-admission.test.mjs
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-maina350-paint-admission.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-mainceb58-paint-admission.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-oct22-pose-pair.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-queue1801-source-pairs.test.mjs
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-atomic-intro.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-boolean-gate.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-audio-readiness-diagnostics.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-menu-start.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-audio-timing-observer.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-roller-birth-baseline.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-main-ink-baseline.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-character-pose-baseline.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-current-owner-admission.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-current-owner-receipts.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-paint-owner-context.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-http-file.test.mjs scripts/tests/inkwave-capture-source-identity.test.mjs
      - name: Prepare isolated pinned-main audio-stabilized reference, retaining pristine main
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && github.event.pull_request.number == 1695 && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && (github.event.pull_request.base.sha == 'ada098a8fe5f2b9f2990f10812c01acb70bde190' || github.event.pull_request.base.sha == 'da285129eb919d094d29e6a9b388f5eeb11059e9') }}
        run: |
          node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-reference-audio.test.mjs
          node scripts/prepare-inkwave-reference-audio.mjs --original .ci-baseline --derived .ci-audio-reference --candidate . --side before --pr 1695 --base-ref main --base-sha "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}" --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/reference-audio-adjustment.json
          echo "INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT=.ci-audio-reference" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          node .ci-baseline/scripts/build-inkwave.mjs .ci-baseline/inkwave-public .built-site/pristine-main
          cp .built-site/pristine-main/inkwave-build.json .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/pristine-main-build.json
      - name: Admit PR1869 immutable source pair without replay
        id: pr1869_current_pair
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1869 || github.head_ref == 'fix/inkwave-ci-composed-regressions-20261024') }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git cat-file -e '890e0ef8ab32238624b6ffff8069e2c9e3515dd6^{commit}' || git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 --filter=blob:none origin 890e0ef8ab32238624b6ffff8069e2c9e3515dd6
          node scripts/verify-inkwave-pr1869-current-pair.mjs --phase source --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --event "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/inkwave-pr1869-${{ matrix.side }}/source.json"
          printf 'admitted=true\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Preserve the two reviewed October 23 production pairs without historical replay
        id: reviewed_current_pair
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.repository == 'rhgrive3/actions' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1857 || github.event.pull_request.number == 1860) }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node scripts/verify-inkwave-projectile-current-pair.mjs --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --event "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/reviewed-current-pair.json
          printf 'admitted=true\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Verify owned PR1862 production pair and rejection controls without replay
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1862 || github.head_ref == 'fix/respawn-weapon-state-20261023') }}
        env:
          DECLARED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          DECLARED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          INKWAVE_RESPAWN_PAIR_BASELINE="$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-respawn1862-production-pair.test.mjs
          node scripts/verify-inkwave-respawn1862-production-pair.mjs --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --base-sha "$DECLARED_BASE_SHA" --candidate-sha "$DECLARED_HEAD_SHA" --expected-mode pr1862-main3003-f253-production-pair --expected-source-base 3003088e7d3da6e3b41829a96714698a348b555b --expected-source-head f253b8aa2e23bcb9e40805a9d389a8220ad6dbec --role controls --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/respawn-production-controls.json
      - name: Admit owned PR1862 production reference without replay
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1862 || github.head_ref == 'fix/respawn-weapon-state-20261023') }}
        env:
          DECLARED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          DECLARED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && github.event.pull_request.number != 1651 && steps.reviewed_current_pair.outputs.admitted != 'true' && github.event.pull_request.number != 1862 && github.head_ref != 'fix/respawn-weapon-state-20261023' && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.number == 1758 || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.repository == 'rhgrive3/actions' && ((github.event.pull_request.number == 1857 && github.head_ref == 'fix/shooter-splatling-cosmetics-20261023') || (github.event.pull_request.number == 1860 && github.head_ref == 'fix/respawn-enemy-exclusion-20261023'))) || github.head_ref == 'test/inkwave-combined-qa-20261021' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.repository == 'rhgrive3/actions' && ((github.head_ref == 'fix/roller-vertical-recovery-20261023' && github.event.pull_request.number == 1856 && github.event.pull_request.base.sha == '3003088e7d3da6e3b41829a96714698a348b555b') || (github.head_ref == 'inkwave/runtime-ui-acceptance-20261022' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha == '26a4db4123d23162a3dbf8a12150b1b5bc6ccf64') || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/special-reviewed-main726-20261023' || github.head_ref == 'integrate/inkwave-all-prs-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'fix/stringer-splatana-review-20261023' || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/exact-head-ci-main144-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/runtime-acceptance-0f3-prep-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/runtime-acceptance-followup-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'inkwave/runtime-main-a350-integration-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'integrate/all-open-prs-20261022' || github.head_ref == 'fix/queue-30-recovery-20261022'))) }}
        run: node scripts/prepare-inkwave-character-pose-baseline.mjs --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/character-pose-adjustment.json
      - name: Verify reviewed PR 1651 sources without rewriting the official reference
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && github.event.pull_request.number == 1651 }}
        run: |
          node scripts/verify-inkwave-projectile-pr-diff-baseline.mjs --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/pr-diff-reference.json
          INKWAVE_PR_DIFF_BASELINE="$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-pr-diff-baseline.test.mjs
      - name: Build selected reference with explicit alignment provenance
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' }}
        run: node "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT/scripts/build-inkwave.mjs" "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT/inkwave-public" .built-site/baseline
      - name: Build complete candidate production composition
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: node scripts/build-inkwave.mjs inkwave-public .built-site/projectiles
      - name: Verify candidate packaging
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: INKWAVE_BUILT_SITE=.built-site/projectiles node --test scripts/tests/inkwave-build-packaging.test.mjs
      - name: Bind PR1869 immutable source receipt to actual side build
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1869 || github.head_ref == 'fix/inkwave-ci-composed-regressions-20261024') }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          PAIR_SIDE: ${{ matrix.side }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$PAIR_SIDE" in
            before) site=.built-site/baseline ;;
            after) site=.built-site/projectiles ;;
            *) echo 'Invalid PR1869 capture side' >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          node scripts/verify-inkwave-pr1869-current-pair.mjs --phase build --baseline "$INKWAVE_REFERENCE_ROOT" --candidate . --event "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" --source-receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/inkwave-pr1869-${{ matrix.side }}/source.json" --side "$PAIR_SIDE" --site "$site" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/inkwave-pr1869-${{ matrix.side }}/build.json"

        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' && github.event.pull_request.number == 1695 && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && (github.event.pull_request.base.sha == 'ada098a8fe5f2b9f2990f10812c01acb70bde190' || github.event.pull_request.base.sha == 'da285129eb919d094d29e6a9b388f5eeb11059e9') }}
        run: |
          node scripts/prepare-inkwave-reference-audio.mjs --verify yes --original .ci-baseline --derived .ci-audio-reference --pristine-build .built-site/pristine-main/inkwave-build.json --derived-build .built-site/baseline/inkwave-build.json --receipt .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/reference-audio-adjustment.json
          cp .built-site/baseline/inkwave-build.json .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/audio-stabilized-reference-build.json
          node --experimental-vm-modules --test patches/local-quality/tests/music-streamed-gap.test.mjs
          INKWAVE_IDLE_BUILD="$PWD/.built-site/baseline" node --experimental-vm-modules --test patches/local-quality/tests/music-streamed-gap.test.mjs
      - name: Capture native reference, not necessarily untouched public main
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'before' }}
        run: node scripts/check-inkwave-projectile-visuals.mjs --site .built-site/baseline --evidence-dir .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before --mode baseline
      - name: Capture candidate native game including desktop and mobile workloads
        if: ${{ matrix.side == 'after' }}
        run: node scripts/check-inkwave-projectile-visuals.mjs --site .built-site/projectiles --evidence-dir .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/after --mode candidate
      - name: Preserve independent capture and original image evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: projectile-capture-${{ matrix.side }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/${{ matrix.side }}/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0
      - name: Preserve PR1869 source and build admission receipts
        if: ${{ always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.number == 1869 || github.head_ref == 'fix/inkwave-ci-composed-regressions-20261024') }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: projectile-pr1869-receipts-${{ matrix.side }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/inkwave-pr1869-${{ matrix.side }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0

  compare:
    name: Compare all 52 original native captures
    needs: capture
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Verify immutable comparison checkout
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retrieve immutable reference capture and alignment receipts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: projectile-capture-before-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before
      - name: Retrieve full candidate capture
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: projectile-capture-after-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/after
      - name: Verify exact paired native physical states, firing workloads and image hashes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Both capture lanes now assert the same 55-degree projection.
          # Require exact camera/physical/image evidence without historical FOV normalization.
          python3 scripts/compare-inkwave-projectile-captures.py --before .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before --after .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/after --output .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/paired-verification.json --require-complete
      - name: Exercise camera, RNG, contact, retirement and paint comparison gates
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: python3 scripts/tests/inkwave-projectile-captures-synthetic.py --before .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/before/projectile-visuals-result.json --after .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/after/projectile-visuals-result.json --out .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/comparator-synthetic-gates.json
      - name: Preserve comparison receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: projectile-comparison-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/paired-verification.json
            .ci-scratch/projectile-visuals/comparator-synthetic-gates.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
